summary: Create a GitHub classic PAT for the portal under Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens > Generate new token (classic) with scopes repo, read:org and workflow as needed.
questions: Which GitHub token scopes does the portal need?
How do I create a GitHub PAT for self-service automation portal?
Does the portal need the workflow scope?

answer_card.title: GitHub PAT for the portal
answer_card.answer_md:
GitHub > profile picture > **Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens > Generate new token (classic)**. Scopes:

- `repo`
- `read:org`
- `workflow` (as needed)

Generate and save the token.
